text: じいさん　なんか　レッドだけ　ひいき　してねー？

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on now. してねー is a rough, squashed way of saying していない, and with a rising voice it asks 'aren't you?'. ひいき してねー？ = 'aren't you favoring him?'

patterns.name: 〜だけ
patterns.explanation: だけ after a word means 'only' that one and nobody else. レッドだけ = 'only Red'.
